meta.summary: AI spend envelopes set at 0.5x sector median for a 1200-employee manufacturing company experimenting with AI, with normal-strictness controls on agents, routing, and shadow subscriptions.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable if an approved equivalent exists on the company allowlist or if the team has reached its subscription threshold.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn reaches 82% before month end
Team envelope burn reaches 100% with more than 5 days remaining in month
Company envelope burn reaches 110% or unattributed spend exceeds $500 in a rolling 24-hour window

rationales.e1: Support team daily run rate of $211 on Claude Sonnet maps to roughly $6,300/month, within the $1,500 Support envelope when attributed correctly; production inference in a customer-facing triage service is classified COGS under the environment:production rule.
rationales.e2: Data team nightly embeddings job at $38/day is approximately $1,140/month, within the $1,000 Data envelope at normal variance; routine batch workload on an allowlisted provider, no action required.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 35% variance band on the Engineering envelope; likely cause is a model-tier upgrade or prompt-length regression introduced in the deploy, requiring Engineering lead review.
rationales.e4: Marketing has now recorded three ChatGPT Team subscriptions this quarter, reaching the team_subscription_threshold of 3; this charge is rerouted to the approved OpenAI enterprise agreement per the shadow AI policy.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $4,000 fine_tune_over_usd threshold and requires Engineering lead approval before the job is queued.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 25-retry limit, and its $47/hr burn rate exceeded the $40/hr kill threshold; the agent was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled spend.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is approved: the request falls within the 72-hour window and the incremental cost is within the $250 max_delta_usd cap, with Engineering lead sign-off.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key running at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers ladder step 2 throttle; spend is paused for 48 hours pending Engineering lead attribution review, preserving the experimentation carve-out once tagged.
rationales.e9: Procurement agent dataset license purchase of $499 is within the $600 single_txn_ceiling_usd and falls under the data-licensing merchant scope; transaction is approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video trial at $89/month duplicates a Sales-held tool with 40% seat utilization and $1,400/year contract value; consolidating to the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: A $120 charge from an unrecognized inference provider in Engineering triggers the new_provider_rule; spend is held and Engineering lead must complete the provider approval questionnaire before further charges are processed.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged internal-tool was misclassified as COGS; the classification rule match:project_tag value:internal-tool overrides to OpEx and the transaction is corrected.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining has crossed the 82% burn_alert_pct threshold; the alert has fired and team leads are notified to pace remaining spend, no throttle required yet.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes within policy bands, one open provider approval pending for e11, and the e6 agent termination logged for Growth team retrospective.
